rooms.14161: Iron braziers on tall tripods burn with a low, greenish flame, throwing the shadows of bone pillars across the floor. The chamber is square and high, its black stone walls hung with shields hacked nearly in two. A broad arch opens east into more of the guardian chambers, while a narrower passage slopes away south into deeper gloom. Ash drifts in the corners like grey snow that never melts.
rooms.22101: No flame burns in this chamber, and the dark seems to press against the eyes like a cold hand. Footsteps ring on iron plates bolted over the floor, each one stamped with a skull worn smooth by passing boots. The walls sweat a black, oily damp that smells of rust and old blood. The passage carries on north toward the lit chambers and south into a last, closed-in room.
rooms.14163: The guardian chambers end here in a cramped room of black stone with only one way out, back north. Rows of iron hooks line the walls, and from a few still hang the rotted straps of armour long since taken down. A stone bench runs along the far wall, its surface scored with tally marks scratched by some long-dead watcher. The air is stale and still.
rooms.14145: The inner corridor runs straight and narrow between walls of fitted black stone, its ceiling lost in shadow overhead. Eastward the passage opens onto the junction of the inner halls, where several ways meet. To the west the corridor stretches on, lit by iron cressets set in the wall at long intervals. Flakes of burned banner cloth crunch underfoot like dead leaves.
rooms.14146: Here the corridor's walls are studded with iron spikes driven into the mortar at the height of a man's chest, so that the middle of the floor is the only safe place to walk. A thin wind moans along the passage from somewhere far off, carrying the smell of ash. The corridor leads on east and west, its flagstones cracked and heaved. Old scorch marks blacken the stone in long streaks.
rooms.14147: The corridor widens a little at a heavy doorway set in its north wall, its lintel carved with a row of grinning skulls. Beyond the door lies a guard room, its threshold worn hollow by generations of boots. East the corridor runs back toward the inner halls, and west it narrows toward its end. A rack bolted to the wall here holds nothing now but rust and dust.
rooms.14148: This low guard room is cramped and smoky, its single brazier long gone cold beneath a crust of ash. A battered table stands in the middle, ringed by stools of bone and iron, and a game board has been scratched deep into its top. Weapon racks along the walls stand empty, their pegs snapped off. The only door leads back south into the inner corridor.
rooms.14149: The inner corridor ends abruptly against a wall of rubble, where a ceiling vault has come down in a heap of black stone and broken bone. Iron spikes jut from the debris at crooked angles like the ribs of some great carcass. Cold air seeps between the stones, smelling faintly of earth and decay. The only way onward is back east along the corridor.
rooms.14200: A path of broken flagstones skirts the foot of the castle's black outer wall, which rises sheer and windowless overhead. Under a sky the colour of old ash, a cold wind drives grit along the stones. East a fainter track branches off through the rubble toward the Lost Castle, while the pathway around the castle follows the wall west. Rusted iron spikes crown the battlements far above.
rooms.14201: The pathway runs on between the castle wall and a steep drop strewn with fallen masonry. Bones lie half-buried in the ash along the edge, bleached grey by wind and time. Thin clouds race low over the battlements, and no bird calls anywhere. The way leads east and west along the wall.
rooms.14202: A burned banner hangs from an iron pole jammed between two flagstones, its cloth reduced to black tatters that snap in the wind. The castle wall here is pocked with old scars where siege stones struck it and failed. Ash lies ankle-deep in the hollows of the path, which runs on to the east and west. The air tastes of smoke, though no fire burns.
rooms.14203: The path dips into a shallow trough where rainwater has pooled, black and still, reflecting a bruised sky. Rust stains streak down the castle wall above it from a row of iron rings set high in the stone. The pathway climbs out again to the east and west, its edges crumbling. A deep silence hangs over everything, broken only by the wind.
rooms.14204: Here the wall bends, and the pathway follows it around the corner of a squat tower whose arrow slits are dark and empty. Shattered weapons are heaped against the tower's foot, a war trophy left to rust where it was flung. East the path runs back along the wall, and west it continues toward another turn. Ash swirls in small eddies at the tower's base.
rooms.14214: The pathway turns sharply here at the castle's corner, leaving the long wall to the east and running south along the next face of the fortress. A cairn of skulls, cemented together with black mortar, marks the bend like a grim milestone. The wind is stronger at the corner, tugging at cloaks and hair. Grey cloud hangs so low it seems to scrape the battlements.
rooms.14215: The path runs straight along the foot of the wall, hemmed in on the other side by a ditch choked with rubble and charred timbers. Iron spikes have been driven into the ditch's lip, points outward, rusted to the colour of dried blood. The way goes on north toward the corner and south beside the wall. Ash falls lightly from the sky in a slow grey drift.
rooms.14216: Flagstones give way here to packed black earth, cracked into plates by drought and cold. A great iron chain hangs down the castle wall from somewhere above, its lowest links buried in the ground. The pathway leads north and south, following the line of the wall. The air is bitter and dry, and it smells faintly of sulphur.
rooms.14217: A crumbled buttress juts out from the wall, forcing the path to squeeze between it and the edge of the drop beyond. Loose stones skitter away underfoot and vanish without a sound. North and south the pathway runs on, a little wider on either side. Above, the wind whistles through gaps in the battlements like a mournful horn.
rooms.14218: The ground is littered with shards of bone here, crushed so fine in places that it crunches like gravel. A portcullis is set into the castle wall, sealed shut long ago and fused by rust into the stone. The path continues north and south along the fortress. Pale light leaks through the clouds without any warmth in it.
rooms.14219: Ahead the pathway plunges into the black mouth of a covered passage cut through a jutting bastion, and the open sky ends at its lip. The stones around the opening are blackened as if by a great fire. North the path runs back along the open wall. A stale, cold draught breathes out of the dark to the south, carrying a smell of rust.
rooms.22153: Inside the bastion the passage is pitch black and close, and the floor slopes treacherously under a slick of black ooze. Too late, a flagstone shifts and tilts, tipping everything on it into a pit bristling with iron stakes. Faint grey light marks the way back north and an opening to the south, both suddenly far out of reach. The stink of old death rises from below.
rooms.14221: Between two bastions the pathway emerges briefly under the open sky, a narrow ledge of cracked stone pinned against the castle wall. Ash-grey cloud boils overhead, and a cold rain spits from it in fitful gusts. Covered passages yawn at either end, one north and one south, both dark as a throat. Scraps of rotted rope dangle from rings in the wall above.
rooms.22154: This covered passage is so low that its ceiling of iron-banded stone almost brushes the head. A grinding of hidden chains sounds in the walls as the ceiling lurches and begins to descend. Rubble narrows the way south, and the way north seems impossibly distant behind. Dust sifts down in choking streams from the cracks above.
rooms.14223: The pathway leaves the dark passage for grey daylight once more, running beside the wall over ground heaped with fallen slates. A shattered siege engine lies on its side against the wall, its timbers charred and its throwing arm snapped. North the passage gapes black, and the path leads south toward a meeting of ways. The wind carries the dry rattle of loose slate.
rooms.14224: Several paths meet here on a flat of ash-covered stone at the castle's foot. The pathway around the castle runs east along the wall and north back toward the bastions, while a rougher track breaks away west toward the high, wind-scoured promontory of Ocam's Reach. An iron post leans at the junction, a skull nailed to its top as though to point the way. The gale coming off the promontory is bitterly cold.
rooms.14225: The path narrows along a stretch of wall where great blocks have sheared away, leaving the rubble core beneath exposed like a wound. Thorny black weeds grow from the cracks, the only living thing in sight. West lies the meeting of paths, and east the way disappears into another dark, roofed passage. The sky above is heavy and bruised.
rooms.22176: The roofed passage is utterly dark, and the air inside is warm and wet with a sickly, sweet stench. Thin wires stretched across the floor at ankle height trigger great scything blades that swing out of slots in the walls. The way runs on east and back west, though few who come this far ever reach either. Old stains blacken the stones underfoot.
rooms.22105: The passage continues in darkness beneath a vaulted roof, its walls lined with iron brackets that once held lamps and now hold only soot. Water drips steadily from somewhere overhead, each drop loud in the silence. The passage leads east and west, its floor slick and uneven. Scratches gouged low in the stone look like the marks of desperate fingers.
rooms.22035: The covered pathway ends here at a wall of black stone sealed with iron bands as thick as a man's arm. Nothing stirs in the darkness, and the silence is so complete that the blood can be heard rushing in the ears. A heap of broken shields and snapped spears has been piled against the dead end like a trophy of some forgotten rout. The only way out lies back west.
rooms.14229: The track toward Ocam's Reach climbs away from the castle wall across a bare, wind-scoured slope of black rock. Nothing grows here, and the gale shrieks unchecked, flinging grit and ash into the face. East the track drops back to the meeting of paths below the castle, and west it enters a dark, roofed cutting in the rock. Far off, the promontory juts out against a leaden sky.
rooms.22177: The roofed cutting is black as pitch, its rough walls sweating cold water. Halfway along, the floor is hollow, and it gives way with a crack of rotten timber over a shaft that drops into the dark. The way back east and the way on west are only a few strides off, yet out of reach in the gloom. The wind moans across the shaft's mouth like a voice.
rooms.22158: Here the passage is narrow and lined with plates of rusted iron, riveted edge to edge from floor to ceiling. Each step presses a hidden plate, and somewhere in the walls a mechanism clanks as rows of spikes shoot out from the seams. The passage runs east and west, both ends lost in darkness. The air reeks of old oil and rust.
rooms.22106: This stretch of the pathway is quieter, a vaulted hall of black stone whose floor is strewn with ash and shards of pottery. West the hall narrows toward a heavy door of bone and iron, and east it runs back into the iron-plated passage. Faded paintings on the walls show four riders beneath a burning sky, their colours long since flaked away. The cold here seeps into the bones.
rooms.22160: A short, crooked passage drops away from the door of bone and iron, its floor polished slick by something that oozes from the walls. The slope steepens without warning into a chute that ends in a nest of upturned blades. North lies the narrow hall with the door, and west the passage levels toward another chamber. A sweet, rotten smell hangs in the dark.
rooms.22028: This is a wide, low chamber where the dark is deeper than anywhere else, so that even a torch seems to burn small and dim. The stone floor is cold as a grave, and a fine grey dust lies over it untouched. South the air grows hot and dry, and a low throb like a drum rolls up from that way. East a crooked passage climbs back toward the door of bone and iron.
rooms.22107: The passage runs north and south through a hall of black stone, its walls carved with rows of hollow-eyed faces. South the way leads among cold, blackened braziers, while north the pathway continues into deeper darkness. Grit and ash have drifted against the walls in long ridges. The air is close and smells of stale smoke.
rooms.22108: Iron spikes jut from the ceiling here, hanging like rows of black icicles over the passage. The floor beneath them is clean, as if swept, which is somehow worse than rubble. The pathway runs on north into silence and south toward the hall of carved faces. A faint, chill draught stirs the dust.
rooms.22164: The floor of this passage is a lattice of iron grates laid over a pit, and the grates are rusted through. One by one they sag and snap under any weight, spilling all upon them onto the spikes below. The passage leads north and south, though the grates between are the only way across. A hot, foul breath rises from the depths.
rooms.22165: The passage turns a sharp corner here, and in the angle stands a statue of an armoured rider on a gaunt horse, its stone arm raised. The sword in its fist is no carving but real iron, and it swings down on a hidden hinge at anyone who passes beneath. The way bends from south to east around the statue's base. Dark stains spatter the plinth.
rooms.22109: This chamber is a brief pause in the pathway's menace, a bare square room with a domed roof lost in shadow. War trophies cover the walls: broken helms, shields split down the middle, and the rusted heads of pikes, all nailed fast to the stone. West a passage leads back toward the statue of the rider, and north another opens into darkness. Ash has settled thickly on every ledge.
rooms.22166: The ceiling of this passage is a single slab of black stone held up by wooden props, rotten and leaning. A careless step jars them loose, and the whole slab comes down with a roar that shakes the castle to its roots. The passage runs from south to east beneath the slab. Splinters and grey dust cover the floor.
rooms.22167: Thick, greenish fumes pool along the floor of this long passage, rising from cracks in the stone. The air burns the throat at the first breath and seals it shut at the second. East and west the passage stretches on, its far ends blurred by the poisoned haze. Mold furs the walls in pale, sickly patches.
rooms.22110: Here the pathway reaches the foot of Ocam's Reach, where the castle's stonework gives way to raw black rock cut through by hand. The wind can be heard howling somewhere above, though no breath of it reaches this place. North a passage rises into the promontory itself, and west the way leads back toward the fumes. Rust-red streaks run down the rock like old blood.
rooms.22168: Inside the promontory the passage is cut through black rock and pierced with slits that open onto the howling sky beyond. The wind tears through them with such force that it can hurl a body against the far wall, where barbed iron hooks wait in rows. The passage leads north deeper into the Reach and south back toward the castle. Shrieking gusts make thought nearly impossible.
rooms.22169: Four ways meet in this cramped hall at the heart of Ocam's Reach, and every one of them is a snare. East a doorway marked with a carved sword opens onto Ocam's Weapon's, and west another, marked with a carved breastplate, leads to Ocam's Armor's. North the corridor tightens among spines of iron, and south it runs back the way it came. The floor in the middle is a trapdoor, and it swings open with a hollow bang.
rooms.22174: What was once a storeroom for food is now a cellar of rot, its shelves collapsed under the weight of mold and black slime. The floor gives under any foot like soft earth, and beneath the crust lies a vat of something thick that swallows whatever falls in. A low doorway leads back west into the Reach. The stench is overpowering.
rooms.22175: Shelves of shattered glass line this small chamber, and strange sigils are painted in faded silver across its floor. The moment anything crosses the sigils they flare white, and a searing blast of old sorcery fills the room. A doorway opens back east into the Reach, scorched black around its frame. The air crackles and smells of lightning.
rooms.22173: A long bar of black wood runs the length of this low room, its top stained and split, and behind it stand casks with their staves burst. The floorboards before the bar are rotten through, and they give way over a cellar flooded with black, stagnant water. The only door leads back east to the Reach. The sour smell of spilt wine and decay hangs heavy.
rooms.22171: Empty armour stands in ranks around the walls of this narrow room, suits of black plate propped on iron frames as if waiting for wearers. The frames are linked by hidden chains, and at a touch the whole line topples inward with a crash of steel. The doorway back east to the hall of the Reach is the only way out. Rust lies thick upon every plate.

14163.description: Hundreds of short scratches are cut into the bench in groups of five, row upon row. The last group is unfinished, its final stroke trailing off into a long, wavering gouge.

14214.description: The skulls are stacked in a rough cone taller than a man, every one of them facing outward. Some are cracked by blows, and a few still wear rusted fragments of helm.

14223.description: It was a great throwing engine once, its frame of black oak bound with iron. Fire has eaten most of it, and the stone it last loaded still sits in the cup of its broken arm.

22106.description: Four riders gallop across the plaster, one on a white horse, one on red, one on black and one on a pale, sickly grey. Beneath their hooves the painted world burns.

22165.description: The rider wears plate carved in fine detail, and its face is hidden behind a closed helm. The iron sword is notched and dark with old stains, and its hinge is greased.

22175.description: The sigils form a ring of linked hooks and eyes, painted in silver gone dull. A few lines are scorched as if the paint itself once burned.
